core_obligations: Quasi-affine reduction: the limit is quasi-affine by the detection lemma; write it as an open of an affine.
Relative Spec: the closure is a relative Spec of a colimit algebra; the complement is the limit of closed sets.
Closed-nonempty + topology-limit contradiction: if the complement were nonempty, limit-closed-nonempty plus the topology limit lemma produce a point contradiction; conclude affineness.
proof_roadmap: Relative Spec of the closure algebra.
